system.description:
Grit; 3 Pierce; Close (5 ft). Legendary weapon, linked to the Survivor's Legendary Weapon ability (p74). Wither: a targeted enemy must pass a CR 2 Grit Check or be Weakened (CR -1) for the rest of the Combat Encounter. Vampyric: each successful Strike heals you 1 wound and ticks the Doom Clock up 1 minute.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.149
